name: Privacy vulnerability
description: Personal data collected or processed through DPI is exposed, misused, or observed beyond what individuals consented to or reasonably expect.

name: Digital insecurity
description: DPI systems and the data they hold are vulnerable to breach, tampering, or unauthorized access due to weak technical security controls.

name: Physical insecurity
description: Exposure or misuse of DPI-linked data or credentials creates risk of physical harm to individuals, particularly at-risk groups.

name: Lack of recourse
description: Individuals harmed by DPI have no accessible or effective way to complain, appeal, or seek remedy.

name: Discrimination
description: DPI design or implementation results in unequal treatment or biased outcomes for individuals based on identity or group membership.

name: Unequal access
description: Structural, economic, or infrastructural barriers prevent some individuals or groups from accessing DPI-enabled services on equal terms.

name: Exclusion
description: Mandatory or digital-only channels leave individuals without the capacity or means to use DPI unable to access essential services.

name: Disempowerment
description: Individuals lose meaningful control over their own data and outcomes, and lack agency or channels to influence how DPI affects them.

name: Digital distrust
description: Lack of transparency or independent evidence about how DPI operates undermines public confidence in the system.

name: Weak rule of law
description: DPI is deployed without a clear legal basis, enforceable regulation, or embedded legal safeguards.

name: Weak institutions
description: The institutions responsible for governing, auditing, or overseeing DPI lack the independence, capacity, or evidence base to do so effectively.

name: Technical shortcomings
description: DPI relies on closed, proprietary, or poorly engineered systems that limit interoperability, resilience, or long-term safety.

name: Unsustainability
description: DPI lacks a viable long-term financing, institutional, or environmental model needed to sustain operations.
